name: Into the Darkness
summary: Sergeant Danneth and his squad vanished near Serpent's Coil, south of Nethergarde Keep. You are asked to search the caverns for Danneth, though his chances look poor.

sections.title: A Missing Patrol
sections.body: A wounded soldier returned to Nethergarde Keep with grim news: Sergeant Danneth's squad had been killed or captured near Serpent's Coil. The survivor died a few hours later, and Danneth's fate remains uncertain. You are asked to search the caverns for him, where the patrol was last seen.

faq.answer: Sergeant Danneth led the squad last seen on patrol near Serpent's Coil.
Sergeant Danneth was last seen with his squad near Serpent's Coil, south of Nethergarde Keep.
A wounded member of the squad reported that the others had been killed or captured. That soldier later died.
His fate is unconfirmed, though his chances are considered poor.

faq.q: Why are you searching Serpent's Coil?
faq.answer: You are asked to search the Serpent's Coil caverns for Sergeant Danneth.
